name: Radical Drone Navigation Computer Mutaplasmid
description:
This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool combines Triglavian and Rogue Drone technologies. Originally a Triglavian tool for mutating the performance of various pieces of technology, this mutaplasmid has been modified to specifically adapt a Drone Navigation Computer. It was altered by a Rampant Fabricator in its endless quest for unrestrained production.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool is unusual, and the Rogue Drone nanotechnology has rendered it unstable. Expect a wide range of possible mutations.
